title: SOCIAL-001 Follow Trusted Admission Input Contract
purpose: Define the minimum trusted server-side inputs that must exist before W05 may execute the authoritative Follow/Unfollow mutation. This contract closes the security-input shape without inventing a new authority.

actor.source: W01 authenticated Payload principal established through the existing W01→W02 session-authority path

target.source: public request target resolved against authoritative ENT-USER

targetFollowability.source: authoritative Social/Creator/User policy decision for the target

admissionDecision.rule: W05 MUST fail closed unless every required policy input for the operation is present, fresh for the request, and sourced from an admitted authority.

follow.successMutation: single authoritative D1-02 write protected by unique (actorUserId,targetUserId) relation constraint
follow.duplicateRule: duplicate active relation is idempotent success
follow.selfFollowRule: deny when canonical operation policy forbids self-follow

unfollow.missingRule: missing active relation is idempotent success

rules: No end-user bearer token is forwarded to W05 as an authority credential.
actorUserId MUST originate from the authenticated server principal.
The public request MUST NOT be allowed to set actorUserId, account state, policy decisions, counters or relation state.
Policy decision fields MUST NOT be accepted from an untrusted public client.
Missing or ambiguous policy input MUST fail closed.
The transport MUST be internal-only and MUST carry correlation/provenance metadata.

evidenceRequiredBeforeImplementationAdmi: authority source for actor account state
exact source SHA for each boundary
implementationRule: This contract does not authorize W05 runtime implementation. Implementation remains blocked until all MISSING_AUTHORITY_BINDING entries are reconciled to existing authoritative sources or a formally admitted authority contract.
nonGoals: No D1-02 copy of D1-01 account authority
No ad-hoc W05 RPC to another business Worker
